summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of Likers Preview + App-wide Dark Mode on the Expo web preview. All features working as specified. Login (reese@teebox.demo/password123) succeeded. Feed shows the 'round-card-like-preview-<id>' line only on cards with like_count>0 (1 of 4 seed cards) with text 'Liked by Kurt Hafeken' - matches expected format. Tapping the preview line and the like-count button both open the likers-sheet correctly. On post detail (/post/<id>), the 'post-like-preview' element is present and opens the likers-sheet. Dark mode: Selecting 'Dark' in Settings > Appearance turned the entire app dark; verified computed root background = rgb(15,21,18) (#0F1512, dark surface) on Settings, More, Feed, Discover, Log, Profile (self), Notifications, Achievements, Course detail (Cypress Ridge), another user's profile (/user/747a...), and Post detail. No white/blank screens, no red-box crashes, no page errors. Reverting to 'Light' correctly restored rgb(253,252,248) (#FDFCF8) across app. Selecting 'System' did not crash. Regression: login, tab navigation (Feed/Discover/Log/More), opening a post, and the likers sheet all still function. Minor console warnings observed (non-blocking): RN Web deprecation of 'shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents' - repeated many times per navigation.

issues: RN Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Emitted repeatedly. src/theme.ts already uses Platform.select for shadow, so the leaked shadow* usage is elsewhere - grep for shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowOffset/shadowRadius outside theme.ts.

RN Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Present in RoundCard.tsx modalKav (Modal + KeyboardAvoidingView pointerEvents='box-none') and likely a few other Modals - migrate to style.pointerEvents.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' - fires on every navigation. src/theme.ts is safe (Platform.select). Search for stray shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius on web outside the shared theme.

Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. e.g. /app/frontend/src/components/RoundCard.tsx:346 (KeyboardAvoidingView pointerEvents='box-none'). Move to style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}.
expo start reports expo@54.0.35 vs expected ~54.0.36. Non-blocking but should be aligned via `npx expo install --check` or bump in package.json.
